messages.subject: R session crash (Ubuntu 16.04, R 3.3.0, stan 2.12.1)
parts:
Hello all,
I've just installed the latest stan version (2.12.1)  but it's crashing R (3.3.0, running on Ubuntu 16.04, information below). I did a remove and install with the same result. 

I'm posting to this list in the hopes someone can help me figuring out how to make it work.
Thanks in advance for any tip !

        Emmanuelle

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] R session crash (Ubuntu 16.04, R 3.3.0, stan 2.12.1)

Hi Emmanuelle,

Could you type sessionInfo() in R after loading rstan and sending the output along?

So:
> library(rstan)
> sessionInfo()

Hopefully it'll tell is which package versions are loaded.



Daniel

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] R session crash (Ubuntu 16.04, R 3.3.0, stan 2.12.1)
parts:
I've seen problems like this when Rcpp and inline are either out if synch or if they are compiled with different options. 

Could you try uninstalling those two packages, then reinstalling them? I don't think you'll need to reinstall RStan after that. 


Daniel
